start: Timestamp of owner-authorised first public downloadable release
success: >=30 downloads/uses OR >=10 repository stars OR >=3 substantive external bug/feature reports from distinct users
kill: <5 downloads/uses after a reasonable discoverability attempt
reasonableDiscoverability: An indexed public repository/release, a Godot/Android-focused README and up to two owner-approved free posts to relevant existing developer channels during the first seven days; obey channel rules and do not spam or invent contacts.

measures.downloads: Release-asset download-count deltas, excluding known owner/internal tests; clones/views are not downloads or verified use. Unknown bot/repeat activity is disclosed.
measures.stars: Net repository stars at day 30 excluding known owner/internal accounts; do not solicit reciprocal/artificial stars.
measures.feedback: Substantive independent external reports with an actionable reproducible finding, useful compatibility evidence or a concrete developer workflow need; exclude spam, praise, internal tests and duplicates. Multiple messages on one finding count once. The success threshold requires at least three distinct external users; one user cannot count three times. The success threshold requires at least three distinct external users; one user cannot count three times.
measures.uses: Voluntarily reported actual use, deduplicated where feasible; no telemetry or invented conversion denominator. Never add a user's self-report to downloads as a second download.
measures.adoption: Use the larger of eligible download count or deduplicated verified-use count, never their sum; disclose uncertain repeats/bots. Preserve each raw measure.

collection: Freeze package/hash and release timestamp; record counters on days 0, 7, 14 and 30 with dated source evidence. Keep private raw feedback separate from public samples.
interpretation: Evaluate SUCCESS first. Then WEAK if its exact conditions hold. Apply KILL only with the registered discoverability attempt evidenced. Other combinations or missing measurement/discoverability are INCONCLUSIVE, not threshold changes. Report genuine engagement below three separately. No revenue or causality inference from free adoption.
ownerGate: Approve exact sanitised package, MIT rights/attribution, public repository/release destination and exact discovery-post text/channels before any publication or sending.
nextPaidDecision: Only after demand evidence; no paid layer, subscription, account action or spend in this probe.
hypothesis: Godot Android developers will use a free release-preflight tool that catches Android release problems and produces rejectable evidence.
